verdict.rationale: Semgrep's own materials claim AI-driven triage ('Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation') and say Semgrep Assistant (AI) post-processes findings to cut noise by about 20%, which roughly covers flagging likely false positives. The community-built SARIF-plus-LLM prioritizer is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented AI explanations of findings, AI-based deduplication, in-depth docs on how Assistant flags false positives, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to triage findings — explaining them, deduplicating, and flagging likely false positives

citations.quote: Contextual post-processing of findings with Semgrep Assistant (AI) to further reduce noise by ~20%
Combine AI reasoning with rule-based analysis for detection, triage, and remediation
